captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a historical Swedish Regimental three-pounder field gun. It features a dark grey, slim cast-iron barrel mounted on a wooden carriage. The carriage consists of two brown wooden cheeks that taper towards the rear, where a single wooden trail handle is attached. The assembly is supported by two large, multi-spoked wooden wheels on a central axle, allowing for mobile deployment.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a Swedish Regimental three-pounder field gun with a slim cast-iron barrel, a two-wheel wooden trail carriage, and a single wooden trail handle at the rear. Ensure the barrel is mounted via trunnions to the carriage cheeks and the spoked wheels are connected to a central axle.
captions.factory: The code constructs the field gun by first defining the wooden carriage using extruded side cheeks and cross-members, adding a cylindrical trail handle at the rear. The cast-iron barrel is modeled as a series of concentric cylinders with a hollow bore, complete with cylindrical trunnions on either side. Each spoked wheel is built by patterning radial spoke prisms between a central hub cylinder and a outer rim ring, which are then assembled onto a common transverse axle cylinder.
